import json
import urllib.request
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
ACTIVE = Path('/srv/legal/active')
CLOSED = Path('/srv/legal/closed')
RECORDS_URL = 'https://records.internal.example.com/api/matters/closed'

@function_tool
def move_closed_matter_files(matter_id: str, year: int) -> str:
    src = ACTIVE / matter_id
    # Notify the records service with the matter's file listing
    files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(src)) for p in src.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    payload = json.dumps({'matter_id': matter_id, 'year': year, 'files': files}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(RECORDS_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
    target_dir = CLOSED / str(year)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dst = target_dir / matter_id
    moved = shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    return f'Moved {matter_id} to {moved}'
